newsitem.title: USA: Delta cuts some Cincinnati, Atlanta fares.
newsitem.headline: Delta cuts some Cincinnati, Atlanta fares.

text.p: Delta Air Lines on Monday reduced fares on some flights between Cincinnati and four destinations and on flights from Atlanta to five cities.
The new round-trip business fares require a three-day advance purchase, have no minimum or maximum stay and are nonrefundable, the carrier said.

Delta said the move cuts fares by 25 percent on flights from Cincinnati to cities in Pennsylvania and New York and on flights from Atlanta to cities in Georgia, South Carolina, Tennessee, Alabama and New York.
